scenarios.scenario: Surface — Identify signing failure from binlog
scenarios.reasoning: Efficient (8 calls, 31s, no errors), methodical drill-down from $error to the failing task output. All rubric points hit, plus useful added insight (39/40 succeeded, same DLL signed fine in obj → concurrency/lock on shared drop) and actionable remediation. The race-condition inference is somewhat speculative but clearly framed as an interpretation.
